name: Gemma 4 (Google): 31B, 26B-A4B, 12B, E4B
usage: Image analysis (captions, OCR, handwriting) and general assistant; 12B and E4B also take audio

licence.note: standard Apache 2.0 text, no added clause (Gemma 3 used the Gemma terms)

formats.value: safetensors; official QAT Q4_0 GGUF by Google (with vision projector); GGUF and MLX builds by ggml-org, unsloth, lmstudio-community, mlx-community
formats.note: Google's QAT GGUFs pushed on 15.07.2026 were malformed and fixed on 17.07.2026. mlx-community E4B 4/8-bit declare licence "gemma" instead of Apache 2.0; mlx-community 12B and QAT builds declare no licence and no base model

languages.value: 35+ languages out of the box, pre-trained on 140+ (list not published); multilingual OCR and handwriting claimed
languages.note: no first-hand report found on French, German or Italian OCR

runtimes.value: llama.cpp with mmproj (image budget set with --image-min-tokens / --image-max-tokens); Ollama gemma4 (GGUF and MLX tags; dynamic image budget for GGUF since 0.34.1); mlx-vlm; LM Studio (image budget not configurable, #1898)
runtimes.note: Open issues: 12B unusable in Ollama on Apple silicon (#16562); 31B hangs on Ollama's MLX engine on an M5 Pro (#17426); bounding boxes offset in llama.cpp on Metal (#21631); LM Studio MLX 26B QAT ignores the image (#2265). For OCR, Google recommends an image budget of 1120 tokens.

fits_128gb.note: every size fits, bf16 included (31B bf16 62.6 GB)

web.verdict: Strong vision for its size (12B and 26B-A4B most praised); weak at tool calling; set the image budget to 1120 tokens
web.summary: Users praise the 12B and the 26B-A4B for image understanding, handwriting and speed; the 26B-A4B is very fast on Apple silicon. Captions are less specific than Qwen3.8-27B or MiniCPM-V 4.7 in one sweep. Weak points: tool calling and instruction following (31B), template loops (fixed in July), runtime bugs in Ollama and LM Studio on Macs. No report on French, German or Italian OCR.
web.scope: Searched on 15.11.2026. Released 02.04.2026 (12B about 03.06.2026); window: since 15.05.2026 plus the launch discussion. Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, llama.cpp, Ollama, mlx-vlm and LM Studio issues. Reddit could not be read.

comments.text: 12B: the most effective vision model one user tested, including models several times its size ([SwellJoe, 23.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48645351)).
12B 4-bit used to sort, classify and describe images ([SwellJoe, 14.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49304989)).
12B reads tiny text, gives bounding boxes and transcribes audio, 7 GB with its projector ([CMay, 17.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49327574)).
12B QAT image analysis called the most interesting open release of the year ([dofm, 15.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50104808)).
26B-A4B: best handwriting recognition one user tried, ahead of Qwen3-VL-8B and GLM-OCR ([physicles, 22.04.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47870197)).
26B-A4B: solid image analysis and good OCR on very tough images ([ekidd, 22.04.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47860412)).
26B-A4B via llama.cpp for privacy-sensitive image processing ([deniska, 09.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50023492)).
26B-A4B beats Mistral Small 4 on a business benchmark that includes German writing ([nik736, 08.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49611637)).
31B: French→English round trip "perfectly readable", a few awkward phrasings ([lambda, 13.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48511050)).
26B-A4B and 12B: clean captions but less specific than Qwen3.8-27B and MiniCPM-V 4.7 in a captioning sweep ([mlx-vlm #2546, 17.10.2026](https://github.com/Neywa-Labs/mlx-vlm/issues/2546)).

Qwen 3.5/3.6 35B-A3B "WAY better with vision" than the 26B-A4B ([jwr, 18.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48182721)); a reply asks whether the image budget was the default 280 tokens ([argee, 19.05.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48195509)).
31B "absurdly weak" at tool calling and instruction following ([coder543, 23.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48648489)).
12B: about 1 in 3,000 adult video frames mis-captioned as involving a child, a risk for moderation ([philipkglass, 21.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48994615)).
12B: degenerate `thought` loops on long agent prompts; chat-template fix by Google on 14.07.2026 ([HF 12B #41](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-12B-it/discussions/41)).
LM Studio does not expose Gemma's image budget, which "made gemma4 useless" for one user ([jwr, 14.08.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49301283)).
